item.summary: fix: local model inference no longer times out during plugin preparation (#126196) * fix(agents): scope simple completion runtime preparation Explicit local model runs no longer build the broad plugin/live model catalog before inference. Related to #125802 and #125834 as discovery context only; this commit does not claim to close either issue. * refactor(agents): simplify runtime scope planning Reuse canonical configured-slot and metadata-snapshot resolution, and consolidate test temp cleanup without changing the selected prepared-runtime contract.
